question_template:
{question}
Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed{{}}.
choice_instruction: For this multiple-choice question, put only the selected option letter inside \boxed{} as the final answer.

grading.gsmhard_integer_references: Exact; do not apply a relative tolerance to large integer answers.
grading.final_answer_format: One final balanced boxed expression; separate multiple complete answers by semicolons; preserve order inside each tuple.

olympiad_reference.adaptation: Use typed tuple/interval/radix/choice comparison and Math-Verify rather than untyped generic parsing. Retain absolute numerical tolerance and one-to-one multi-answer matching. Do not inherit implicit factor-100 percentage acceptance or aggregate every intermediate boxed expression.

grading.revision_reason: Repair currency escaping, complete-group tuple detection, signed radix and clock answers, ordered point lists, and interval unions with finite sets; preserve first audit and its 73 failures.

claim_boundary: Complete five-benchmark predictions for the first S4a student stage: one base model and B1/B4/B5/B7 across three training seeds. One common output cap is frozen from all actual development cells before any benchmark generation. Preserve full cohorts, GSM8K-Hard parent mapping, caps and per-example outputs. Batch-amortized generation time is not isolated query latency. Single-cell merge is not a cross-seed significance analysis, the complete eight-baseline matrix, or the 25K/family/teacher/budget expansion. Later evaluation stages must reconcile decoding-budget parity before combining results. Common-cap admissibility uses every registered cell and exactly its actual inference prompts: natural base and B0-B5/B7, all six ratios for B6 when included. Extra base ratio-prompt development diagnostics do not select the natural-base budget.
